description: This file is a C header file (.h) containing utility function declarations, macros, and constants used for nl80211 wireless interface operations such as attribute parsing, bandwidth conversion, and frequency band translation. It defines interfaces for interaction with nl80211 wireless attributes and conversions between different bandwidth and frequency representations.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getWiphy
methods.description: Extracts the Wiphy ID from nl80211 attributes array.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getIfIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the interface netdev index from nl80211 attributes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getIfName
methods.description: Gets the interface netdev name as a string from nl80211 attributes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwNlToSwl
methods.description: Converts nl80211 bandwidth ID to internal SWL bandwidth enum.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwSwlToNl
methods.description: Converts internal SWL bandwidth enum to nl80211 bandwidth ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwNlToVal
methods.description: Maps nl80211 bandwidth ID to bandwidth value in MHz.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_bwValToNl
methods.description: Maps bandwidth in MHz to nl80211 bandwidth ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_freqBandSwlToNl
methods.description: Converts SWL frequency band enum to nl80211 frequency band ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_freqBandNlToSwl
methods.description: Converts nl80211 frequency band ID to SWL frequency band enum.
